title: Antigravity moved .gs files to subdirectory
detail: Antigravity moved Code.js, TechPWA.gs, DashboardAPI.gs to legacy_gas_archive/. This broke all clasp deployments because .clasp.json has skipSubdirectories: true. Files were immediately restored to repo root.
rule: NEVER move .gs, .js, or .html files from the repo root. They must stay there for clasp to pick them up.

title: Antigravity freelanced on status values
detail: Antigravity introduced 'open', 'pte_pending', 'approval_needed' status strings instead of using the canonical set. Status filter tabs broke — jobs disappeared from queue.
rule: Status values are frozen: New | Ready to Schedule | PTE Required | Awaiting Approval | Scheduled | In Progress | Complete | Archived. Never invent new ones.

title: Claude Code implemented API endpoints instead of speccing
detail: Claude Code wrote new DashboardAPI.gs endpoint functions directly instead of writing a spec for Antigravity. This violated division of labor and wasted tokens on implementation instead of architecture.
rule: Any new .gs function goes through Antigravity via a spec. Claude Code only writes CLAUDE.md, specs, and irreversible sheet operations.

title: Specs missing what NOT to change
detail: Multiple specs described new features without explicitly listing adjacent files/functions to leave unchanged. Antigravity improved working components outside scope and caused regressions.
rule: Every spec must include a 'What NOT to change' section listing exact files, components, and functions to leave untouched.

title: TechPWA.gs TR_COL had wrong ENTITY_ID index
detail: TR_COL.ENTITY_ID was set to 16 (the Hourly Rate column). HOURLY_RATE and PUSH_SUB entries were missing. Read-only bug — no data was corrupted. DashboardAPI.gs had the correct mapping.
rule: Always verify column constant objects against IDENTITY_PRIMARY.md column maps after any .gs edit.

title: Scheduling spreadsheet was Tsegab's, not Keith's
detail: Prior assumptions attributed the scheduling spreadsheet to Keith. Corrected: it was Tsegab's creation. Keith and Tsegab are not on the dispatch team. Robert runs dispatch.
rule: Org structure: Robert=dispatcher, Keith=field/staffing decisions, Tsegab=President/client escalations, Ana=HR.

title: dailyScheduleSheetSync retired — CC2.0 is sole write source for scheduling
detail: dailyScheduleSheetSync() in ScheduleMiner.js was killed (returns immediately). getWeekSchedule reads exclusively from DQ col 18. Old scheduling spreadsheet kept as historical reference only.
rule: Do NOT re-enable dailyScheduleSheetSync. Do NOT add scheduling sheet tab fallback to getWeekSchedule. DQ col 18 is the only source of truth for scheduled dates.
